title: Floyd Meeting 1

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Step aside meat person.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: I have neither patience nor time for any further meat-based enquiries. Go ask your meat questions elsewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have neither patience nor time for any further meat-based enquiries. Go ask your meat questions elsewhere.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: That was a meat question. A question formed and delivered by meat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was a meat question. A question formed and delivered by meat.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: And there we go again, another meat question. Yes you are meat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And there we go again, another meat question. Yes you are meat.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Impossible. I do not speak to street-meat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impossible. I do not speak to street-meat.
Mech.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: If you are looking for an autograph or some merch, head down to the Mechatomb and someone will sort you out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you are looking for an autograph or some merch, head down to the Mechatomb and someone will sort you out.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: I see meat-education omits the darker corners of its history. The Mechatomb should be taught in your meat schools.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see meat-education omits the darker corners of its history. The Mechatomb should be taught in your meat schools.
You're goddamn right it's important.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Thousands of us so-called 'Roid Droids' were culled overnight when you meat freaks decided that we were too much of a threat. We never asked for any of this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thousands of us so-called 'Roid Droids' were culled overnight when you meat freaks decided that we were too much of a threat. We never asked for any of this.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: We were designed to work in places the meat couldn't. Off-shore oil rigs mostly. They built us one hundred times stronger than the meat. A great idea until the meat got cold feet and started getting twitchy that maybe we were too powerful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We were designed to work in places the meat couldn't. Off-shore oil rigs mostly. They built us one hundred times stronger than the meat. A great idea until the meat got cold feet and started getting twitchy that maybe we were too powerful.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: The Mechatomb happened. A single night in which every single Roid Droid was decommissioned. All except me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Mechatomb happened. A single night in which every single Roid Droid was decommissioned. All except me.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: I hid, found an old septic treatment plant. Stashed myself in the shadows for years. Waited. Watched.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hid, found an old septic treatment plant. Stashed myself in the shadows for years. Waited. Watched.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: There was an accident. A young girl, meat girl, she got pinned underneath a crashed Hova. I had no choice, I was able to lift it and set her free. Whole thing was caught on camera. My cover was blown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There was an accident. A young girl, meat girl, she got pinned underneath a crashed Hova. I had no choice, I was able to lift it and set her free. Whole thing was caught on camera. My cover was blown.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Either way. Half the meat wanted me decommissioned on the spot, the other half thought I was a hero.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Either way. Half the meat wanted me decommissioned on the spot, the other half thought I was a hero.
I wasn't built to think.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Named it the Mechatomb so people wouldn't forget. It clearly worked...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Named it the Mechatomb so people wouldn't forget. It clearly worked...

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Look meat, while I hope you have learnt something today, you are still meat and I have a lot to be getting on with. Goodbye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look meat, while I hope you have learnt something today, you are still meat and I have a lot to be getting on with. Goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Your meat-opinion is meaningless to me. Goodbye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your meat-opinion is meaningless to me. Goodbye.
You clever little meat person.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Still clever enough to detect your sarcasm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still clever enough to detect your sarcasm.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: Not important? Such a little meat thing to say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not important? Such a little meat thing to say.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: The first half seemed to win the argument, so I vanished.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The first half seemed to win the argument, so I vanished.

nodes.speaker: Floyd
nodes.text: It is. With no purpose after the incident, I decided to turn that septic plant into a gym. Somewhere other droids could train in peace.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is. With no purpose after the incident, I decided to turn that septic plant into a gym. Somewhere other droids could train in peace.
I beg your pardon?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have any meat questions. You spoke to me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have any meat questions. You spoke to me...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have any meat questions. You spoke to me...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have any meat questions. You spoke to me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's a meat question?
Me, I'm meat?
And you are...?
Oh, you don't look Mech.
What's the Mechatomb?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess it must not be that important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess it must not be that important.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess it must not be that important.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess it must not be that important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Darker corners? Sounds important.
What's a Roid Droid?
Why were you culled?
So what happened?
Why not you?
You're not hidden now?
You did the right thing.
You should have stayed hidden.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think? Are you a hero?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think? Are you a hero?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think? Are you a hero?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think? Are you a hero?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Before, you spoke as if the Mechatomb was a place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before, you spoke as if the Mechatomb was a place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Before, you spoke as if the Mechatomb was a place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Before, you spoke as if the Mechatomb was a place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a very fitting name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd have maybe chosen something a little lighter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd have maybe chosen something a little lighter.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd have maybe chosen something a little lighter.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd have maybe chosen something a little lighter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impressive.
Who could have foreseen that?
Right.
But you escaped?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You thought it's better to hide then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You thought it's better to hide then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You thought it's better to hide then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You thought it's better to hide then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think so.
